## Bio

I am a computational GIScience researcher working on geospatial technologies, spatial analysis and visualization, and reproducibility practices in GIScience. I was a [Ramón y Cajal postdoctoral fellow]((https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ram%C3%B3n_y_Cajal_(scholarship))) (2015–2020), a postdoctoral researcher in the then‑called Digital Earth and Reference Data Unit of the [European Commission’s Joint Research Centre](https://joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu/about-us/jrc-sites-across-europe/jrc-ispra-italy_en) in Ispra, Italy (2011–2014), and both a predoctoral (2003-2026) and postdoctoral researcher at UJI (2006-2010), where I earned my Ph.D. (2006). I was appointed Associate Professor at UJI in 2021.

I was an elected member of the [AGILE Council](https://agile-gi.eu/) (2018-2026), an active team member of the [Reproducible AGILE initiative](https://reproducible-agile.github.io/) (2017-), a member of the [ACM](https://www.acm.org/) (2014-), and a member of [Geospatial Technologies research group (GEOTEC)](https://geotec.uji.es/), part of the [Institute of New Imaging Technologies (INIT)](https://www.init.uji.es/en/home/) at UJI. I have been co-coordinating GEOTEC since November 2022. At GEOTEC, we leverage computing and geospatial technologies to address everyday problems from a multidisciplinary perspective, applying diverse theoretical approaches and practical (geospatial) methods to social and environmental issues such as mobility & transport, public and mental health, environmental health, sustainable cities, and education. 

## Research interests

- **GIScience**: geospatial data science, GeoAI, spatial analysis & visualisation, geospatial data integration.

- **Urban computing**: Computational geospatial technologies & GeoAI to address multidisciplinary problems, specifically in urban contexts, such as mobility, environmental health, and public health.

- **Open science and reproducibility practices (in GIScience)**: Reuse, reproducibility, replicability, transparency, openness, integrity, and ethics -- all in general terms, but applied specifically to computational research in GIScience. 

You can read more about my [research interests](research).

## Teaching

I am a lecturer on spatial data science and thesis supervisor for the [Master of Science in Geospatial Technologies](https://mastergeotech.info/) at UJI, and lecturer in software engineering for the [Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering](https://www.uji.es/estudis/base/2026/graus/informatica-p26/) at UJI.

From time to time I give talks and lectures on reproducibility research practices - you can read more about this in the [teaching section](teaching).

## Selected papers

If I had to choose five articles that define my research interests throughout my past and present career, I would invite you to read the following:

- [GIScience as a meta-science: Why we miss a theory of our geo-information practice](https://josis.org/index.php/josis) - 2026

- [Improving reproducibility of GIScience publications through novel reproducibility guidelines and revised review procedures](https://doi.org/10.5311/JOSIS.2026.32.591) - 2026

- [AwarNS: A framework for developing context-aware reactive mobile applications for health and mental health](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbi.2023.104359) - 2023

- [Seeing the forest through the trees: A review of integrated environmental modelling tools](https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.compenvurbsys.2013.06.001) - 2013

- [Service-oriented applications for environmental models: Reusable geospatial services](https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2009.08.005) - 2010

You can explore the [full list of my publications](papers).
